gemini.title: Religion And Ethnicity Data 2021 Lgd
gemini.abstract: Religion And Ethnicity Data 2021 Lgd is an authoritative dataset published by Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency. It contains records relating to religion and ethnicity data 2021 lgd.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
gemini.responsible_organisation: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
